items.title: Firecrawl PDF Inspector
items.simpleDescription: Firecrawl PDF Inspector быстро определяет, содержит ли PDF нормальный текст или требует OCR, а затем извлекает структуру в Markdown. Это полезный первый этап document pipeline, но не волшебный парсер: сложная вёрстка, повреждённые шрифты и вредоносные файлы всё равно требуют ограничений и fallback.
useCases: Маршрутизировать текстовые и сканированные PDF по разным ingestion pipelines
Извлекать таблицы, заголовки и порядок чтения перед RAG-индексацией
Снизить число документов, которые без необходимости отправляются в дорогой OCR
items.pricing: Open source; local compute, OCR runtimes, storage and any hosted fallback are paid separately
items.trustReason: Official Firecrawl repository, MIT license, documented benchmark configuration and security policy were checked on 18.08.2026. The advertised speed is hardware- and corpus-specific, not a universal SLA.
risks: Crafted or very large PDFs can consume CPU, memory and disk or exploit native parser dependencies
Extraction can silently damage reading order, tables, digits, CJK text or custom-font content
Optional OCR adds PDFium, ONNX Runtime and model supply-chain dependencies
quickStart: Benchmark a pinned version on a frozen Eclipse document corpus before choosing it as the default parser
Run parsing in an isolated worker with file-size, page-count, time, memory and decompression limits
Keep provenance and confidence per page, and route low-confidence output to OCR or manual review
items.description: Rust-first PDF classifier and structure-aware text extractor from Firecrawl. It exposes Rust, Node.js, Python, WebAssembly and CLI interfaces, can identify text, scanned, image and mixed documents, and can route only selected pages to optional OCR. Its published benchmark is reproducible but must be read as a controlled comparison on one corpus and machine.
limitations: No parser can preserve every layout perfectly
Benchmark results do not establish a production SLA
Untrusted documents require a sandbox even when processing is local

items.title: Diagram Design
items.simpleDescription: Diagram Design — MIT skill/plugin для Claude Code, Codex и Pi, который создаёт 27 типов редакционных диаграмм: architecture, flowchart, sequence, state, ER, timeline, charts и другие. It turns an idea into constitution, specification, clarification, technical plan, tasks and implementation. It does not guarantee error-free code: generated specs remain drafts, while tests, security review and human approval stay mandatory.

risks: CLI and templates create repository instructions and command files that affect agent behavior; moving main and unreviewed extensions are supply-chain boundaries.

Build the constitution from AGENTS, CLAUDE and UX/security baselines, then complete specify and clarify before plan/tasks.
Before implement, manually approve plan, non-goals, data boundaries, rollback and quality gates. Keep commit, push and deploy separate.
